mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_tool_deployment_state_receipts(tenant_id,request_id,actor_ref,request_fingerprint,deployment_key,expected_revision,active) VALUES(#{tenant},CAST(#{requestId} AS uuid),#{actor},#{fingerprint},#{deploymentKey},#{expectedRevision},#{active}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id,request_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_tool_deployment_state_receipts SET outcome='SUCCEEDED',deployment_status=#{status},result_revision=#{revision} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND request_id=CAST(#{requestId} AS uuid) AND outcome='PENDING'
UPDATE nw_tool_deployment_state_receipts SET outcome='REJECTED' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND request_id=CAST(#{requestId} AS uuid) AND outcome='PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT actor_ref,request_fingerprint AS fingerprint,deployment_key,outcome,deployment_status,result_revision FROM nw_tool_deployment_state_receipts WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND request_id=CAST(#{requestId} AS uuid)
